title: Formal Complaint Regarding Damaged Airline Luggage
promptText:
You recently returned from an international flight and discovered that your checked suitcase was severely damaged, and several valuable items inside were broken.

Write a letter to the airline's customer service manager. In your letter:
- give the details of your flight and journey
- describe the damage to your suitcase and belongings
- explain what action you expect the airline to take.

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses. Begin your letter as follows: Dear Sir or Madam,

planningGuide.tips: State flight details (Flight QA-402, date, booking ref) and reason for writing (formal claim).
Describe cracked hard-shell case, broken zipper, and shattered camera lens.
Request full reimbursement for replacement suitcase (£180) and itemized contents (£350) within 14 days.
Formal close because recipient is unnamed (Dear Sir or Madam -> Yours faithfully).

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to lodge a formal complaint regarding severe damage incurred to my checked luggage during a recent flight with your airline, and to request immediate financial compensation.

On the 12th of November, I traveled from London Heathrow to Singapore Changi on flight QA-402 (Booking Reference: XJ882K). Upon retrieving my checked baggage from Carousel 4 at the arrival terminal, I was dismayed to discover that my Samsonite hard-shell suitcase had sustained catastrophic damage. The main zipper mechanism had been ripped open, one of the multi-directional castor wheels was entirely sheared off, and the outer polycarbonate shell displayed a deep twenty-centimeter crack.

More distressingly, several delicate items packed inside were damaged due to rough handling. A professional telephoto camera lens, which was securely wrapped in protective clothing, suffered a shattered front element, rendering it unusable. I immediately reported this at your airport baggage service counter and obtained Property Irregularity Report number SINQA99201.

Given that the suitcase was purchased new three months ago and the lens was in pristine condition, I expect full reimbursement for the replacement suitcase (£190) and the insured repair of the camera lens (£320), totaling £510. I have attached the original purchase receipts, photographs of the damage, and the official airport report. I look forward to your prompt response and settlement within fourteen working days.

Yours faithfully,

Julian Montgomery
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Tone: Consistently formal, respectful, and authoritative. Task Achievement: Directly answers all 3 bullet points with specific realistic details (PIR number, exact sums). Lexical Resource: Sophisticated vocabulary ('catastrophic damage', 'sheared off', 'Property Irregularity Report').

checklist: Used 'Dear Sir or Madam' and 'Yours faithfully'

title: Application for Municipal Community Garden Grant
promptText:
Your local city council has announced a grant scheme to fund grassroots neighborhood environmental projects. You would like to apply on behalf of your local residents' association to create a community organic vegetable garden on an unused plot of land.

Write a letter to the Council Community Grants Officer. In your letter:
- explain what project you are proposing and where it will be situated
- describe how the local community will benefit from this project
- detail how the requested grant money will be spent.

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter as follows: Dear Sir or Madam,

planningGuide.tips: Apply on behalf of Oakwood Residents Association for community organic garden on derelict Victoria Road lot.
Provide fresh vegetables for elderly residents, outdoor workshops for children, reduce loneliness.
Request £3,500: topsoil, timber raised beds, irrigation drip lines, native pollinator seedlings.
Express willingness to present project blueprint to council committee.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing on behalf of the Oakwood Residents Association to formally submit an application for the Green Neighborhoods Grant Scheme to establish a community organic garden on Victoria Road.

The proposed site is the vacant municipal allotment situated at the corner of Victoria Road and Elm Street, which has remained derelict and overgrown for the past four years. Our proposal envisions transforming this neglected 400-square-meter parcel into a thriving, accessible community green space featuring raised vegetable beds, a sensory herb terrace, and a modest greenhouse.

This initiative will yield substantial social and ecological dividends for local residents. Firstly, it will serve as an outdoor educational hub where local primary school pupils can learn hands-on horticulture and sustainable composting. Secondly, fresh organic produce harvested from the garden will be distributed free of charge to elderly and low-income residents through the neighboring parish community pantry, fostering civic solidarity and promoting healthy nutrition.

We are requesting a funding allocation of £3,200. This capital will be disbursed exclusively on essential infrastructure, specifically: non-toxic timber for twelve accessible raised planters (£1,200), certified organic topsoil and compost (£800), a solar-powered rainwater harvesting drip irrigation system (£700), and indigenous fruit saplings and seeds (£500). All labor will be provided by volunteer neighborhood working bees.

Thank you for considering our proposal. I would welcome the opportunity to present our comprehensive site layout plans to the evaluation committee.

Yours faithfully,

Clara Bennett
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Flawless formal register. Clear paragraph organization addressing each bullet point with realistic figures and civic purpose. Outstanding vocabulary ('allotment', 'derelict', 'dividends', 'horticulture').

checklist: Addressed all three bullet points in order
Realistic budget breakdown with clear figures

title: Request for Flexible Working Arrangement
promptText:
You have been working at your company for over two years and would like to request a temporary flexible working arrangement (working from home two days per week) to care for an elderly relative.

Write a letter to your departmental manager. In your letter:
- explain your current personal situation
- propose the specific working schedule you would like
- reassure your manager about how you will maintain your performance and teamwork.

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter as follows: Dear Mr./Ms. [Surname],

planningGuide.tips: Polite greeting to manager (Dear Ms. Davies); explain elderly parent's recovery from surgery.
Propose working remotely on Tuesdays and Thursdays, in-office Mon/Wed/Fri for 3 months.
Available via Slack/Teams, shift handover documentation, quarterly project milestones unaffected.
Semi-formal sign-off with manager's name known.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Ms. Davies,

I am writing to formally request a temporary flexible working arrangement for the upcoming three months, starting from the first of next month.

As you may be aware, my elderly mother recently underwent orthopedic surgery and requires ongoing physical therapy and domestic assistance during her rehabilitation. While my siblings and I are sharing caregiving responsibilities, I need to be physically present at her home two days a week to supervise her medical appointments and medication regimen.

To accommodate these personal commitments without interrupting my professional output, I would like to propose a hybrid schedule. Specifically, I propose working in the office on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, while carrying out my duties remotely from home on Tuesdays and Thursdays. My total contracted hours (37.5 hours per week) will remain entirely unchanged.

I want to assure you that this arrangement will not compromise my productivity or responsiveness. I have established a dedicated home workstation with high-speed internet and will remain fully accessible via Microsoft Teams, email, and phone during standard operating hours. Furthermore, all our scheduled departmental sprint meetings fall on Wednesdays, ensuring my uninterrupted in-person attendance. I will continue to meet all project delivery deadlines as normal.

I would be very grateful to discuss this proposal with you at your convenience during our one-on-one catch-up this Thursday.

Yours sincerely,

Marcus Vance
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Tone: Warm yet thoroughly professional (semi-formal). Bullet points covered thoroughly with proactive solutions. Appropriate 'Yours sincerely' for a named recipient.

checklist: Addressed team and operational concerns proactively

title: Explanation of Absence to Adult Evening College Instructor
promptText:
You are enrolled in an evening professional certification course at a local adult education college. Due to an urgent business trip assigned by your employer, you will be unable to attend classes next week.

Write a letter to your course tutor. In your letter:
- explain why you will miss the upcoming classes
- ask how you can catch up on the coursework and missed lecture slides
- arrange a time to submit your upcoming project assignment.

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter as follows: Dear Mr./Ms. [Surname],

planningGuide.tips: Dear Mr. Thornton; explain unexpected corporate assignment to Frankfurt next Tuesday and Thursday.
Ask if recorded seminar videos or lecture slides will be uploaded to the student portal.
Offer to email completed Module 3 case study report by Monday prior to departure.
Semi-formal sign-off.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Mr. Thornton,

I am writing to notify you that I will unfortunately be unable to attend our Advanced Project Management evening seminars next week on Tuesday, the 14th, and Thursday, the 16th of October.

My employer has unexpectedly assigned me to lead an emergency on-site client audit in Frankfurt, which requires my continuous presence overseas from Monday morning until Friday evening. Because this trip is mission-critical for our overseas department, I am unable to reschedule the travel dates.

I am very keen not to fall behind on the curriculum. Could you please advise whether the recorded audio of the seminars and the accompanying slide decks will be uploaded to the college Moodle portal? Additionally, if there are specific textbook chapter readings or group seminar case studies scheduled for those two sessions, I would be grateful if you could share the topics in advance so I can review them while traveling.

Regarding our Module 3 project assignment due next Thursday, I have already completed approximately eighty percent of the required draft. I plan to finalize the analysis over the weekend and email the completed PDF document to you by Monday afternoon, ahead of the official deadline.

Thank you very much for your understanding and guidance.

Yours sincerely,

Rachel Adams
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Polite, considerate, and responsible tone. Every prompt bullet point addressed cleanly with proactive solutions. Excellent semi-formal phrasing.

title: Apology to a Friend for Missing a Special Celebration
promptText:
A close friend recently invited you to their 30th birthday party celebration, but you were unable to attend due to an unexpected family emergency.

Write a letter to your friend. In your letter:
- apologize for missing the party and explain what happened
- ask about how the party went and who was there
- suggest getting together soon to celebrate properly.

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter as follows: Dear [Friend's Name],

planningGuide.tips: Dear Liam; heartfelt apology for missing the 30th milestone; explain sister's sudden hospital admission.
Ask about the venue, the live band, whether mutual friends (e.g. Dave and Sarah) made it.
Invite friend out to their favorite Italian bistro; treat them to dinner and give birthday gift in person.

planningGuide.focus: Warm regards / Best wishes / Lots of love,
planningGuide.tips: Informal sign-off with first name.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Liam,

I am so sorry I missed your 30th birthday party on Saturday night! I was so looking forward to celebrating with you, and I feel terrible that I wasn't able to make it after all the planning you put into it.

Just as I was getting ready to leave the house, my younger sister had a sudden acute allergic reaction and had to be rushed to the emergency room. My parents were away for the weekend, so I had to stay with her at the hospital until the early hours of Sunday morning to ensure she was stable. Thankfully, she is back home now and resting comfortably, but it was quite a scary ordeal.

How did the night go? Did you end up hiring that funk band you mentioned? I really hope you had a blast and that Dave and Sarah made it down from Edinburgh. You must send over some photos of the night whenever you get a free moment!

I'd love to make it up to you and celebrate your milestone properly. Are you free next Saturday evening? I'd love to treat you to dinner at Bella Italia—my treat, of course—and I have your birthday present waiting for you. Let me know if that works for you!

Warmest wishes,

Sam
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Tone: Perfectly informal, heartfelt, and conversational ('feel terrible', 'had a blast', 'my treat, of course'). Phrasal verbs and idioms used naturally and accurately.

checklist: Used 'Dear [First Name]' and warm sign-off ('Warmest wishes')

title: Letter to Local Council Regarding Damaged Street Pavements
promptText:
You live in a neighborhood where the pedestrian pavements have become badly damaged and hazardous to pedestrians.

Write a letter to your local municipal council. In your letter:
- Describe the specific location and condition of the pavements
- Explain the problems and hazards this is causing for local residents
- Suggest specific repairs or improvements that should be undertaken.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to draw your urgent attention to the severely deteriorated state of the pedestrian footpaths along Elmfield Road, directly between the junction with High Street and the entrance to St. Mark's Primary School.

Over the past six months, winter freeze-thaw cycles combined with heavy vehicle mounting have caused extensive crumbling of the concrete paving slabs. Several flagstones are cracked, uneven, and protruding by up to five centimeters, while deep potholes have formed along the curb edge.

This physical deterioration poses acute safety hazards for local residents. Last week, an elderly neighbor suffered a painful fall resulting in a sprained wrist, and parents maneuvering infant prams are frequently forced off the pavement into the roadway to bypass flooded depressions. During evening hours, poor street lighting makes these uneven slabs virtually invisible.

I would urge the council to dispatch a highway inspection officer to assess this stretch immediately. The broken slabs require full re-leveling and replacement with non-slip tarmacadam, and curb drainage should be cleared to prevent water pooling. I look forward to your prompt response regarding your repair schedule.

Yours faithfully,

David Miller
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Addresses all three bullet points with rich, convincing detail. Tone: Consistently formal and polite. Cohesion: Flawless paragraph transitions. Lexical: Precise vocabulary ('deteriorated', 'freeze-thaw cycles', 'tarmacadam').

planningGuide.tips: Mention specific road and nature of pavement defects posing safety risks.
Detail broken slabs, uneven kerbs, and a resident near-fall.
Ask for site inspection and paving resurfacing within two weeks.
Use Yours faithfully with full name.

title: Letter to University Accommodation Office Requesting Room Transfer
promptText:
You are an undergraduate student living in university halls of residence. You are having persistent problems with your current accommodation.

Write a letter to the University Accommodation Officer. In your letter:
- State your room details and explain the issues you are facing
- Explain how these problems are affecting your academic studies and wellbeing
- Request a transfer to an alternative room and state your room preferences.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Accommodation Officer,

I am writing to formally request a transfer from my current room in the university halls of residence for the remainder of this academic year.

I currently reside in Room 42, Block B of Glenfield Hall. My primary concern stems from the fact that my bedroom is situated immediately adjacent to the building's central heating boiler room and service lift shaft. The machinery generates a continuous mechanical vibration and low-frequency drone that persists throughout the night. Furthermore, the single-glazed window does not seal properly, allowing severe cold draughts into the room.

These disturbances are severely disrupting my nightly sleep. Chronic fatigue is impairing my concentration during morning lectures, and I am struggling to complete coursework assignments in my room due to the unrelenting noise.

I would be extremely grateful if you could arrange to transfer me to a quieter room, ideally on a higher floor in Block C or D facing away from the service courtyards. I am prepared to move my personal belongings at short notice.

Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Yours sincerely,

Ayesha Khan
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Fully satisfies all prompts. Tone: Respectful, clear, and professional. Lexical Resource: Natural academic expressions ('unrelenting noise', 'chronic fatigue').

planningGuide.tips: State current hall, room number, student ID, and explicit request to move.
Describe persistent corridor noise and lack of adequate natural lighting affecting study.
Request quiet block single room and express willingness to pay rate differential.
Use Yours sincerely or Yours faithfully.

title: Letter of Apology to a Colleague for Missing an Important Meeting
promptText:
You were scheduled to attend an important project planning meeting with a colleague, but you were unable to attend at the last minute.

Write an email to your colleague. In your email:
- Apologize for your absence and explain why you missed the meeting
- Explain how you have reviewed the meeting notes or caught up on the discussion
- Propose a convenient time to meet and discuss your allocated tasks.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Marcus,

I am writing to offer my sincere apologies for failing to attend our scheduled quarterly project planning session yesterday afternoon.

Just twenty minutes before our meeting was due to start, I received an urgent call regarding a domestic plumbing emergency at my home. A burst water pipe was flooding my ground floor, and I had to leave the office immediately to turn off the main water stopcock and wait for an emergency plumber. In the ensuing rush, I was unfortunately unable to notify you in advance.

I have thoroughly reviewed the minutes and presentation slides that Sarah kindly circulated this morning. I am fully up to speed with the revised client milestones for Phase Two, and I have already begun drafting the technical risk assessment matrix that was assigned to our team.

Could we perhaps arrange a brief thirty-minute catch-up tomorrow morning around ten AM over coffee to review my initial draft? If that does not suit your schedule, please let me know when you might be free.

Once again, I apologize for any inconvenience caused by my sudden absence.

Best regards,

Alex Turner
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Clear explanation of unexpected emergency with polite follow-up. Tone: Warm yet professional semi-formal register.

planningGuide.tips: Acknowledge missing the quarterly project alignment meeting.
Outline unexpected vehicle breakdown / travel disruption calmly without over-dramatizing.
State review of minutes and offer to take on assigned sprint actions.
Use Warm regards or Best regards.

title: Letter to Airline Complaining About Damaged Luggage
promptText:
You recently took a flight, and when you collected your suitcase from the baggage carousel, you discovered it was badly damaged and some items were missing.

Write a letter to the airline's customer service department. In your letter:
- Provide your flight details and describe the damage to your suitcase
- Detail the missing items and their approximate value
- State what compensation or action you expect the airline to take.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Customer Relations Manager,

I am writing to file a formal compensation claim regarding severe luggage damage and property loss incurred during my recent flight with your airline.

I traveled on flight BA 2490 from London Heathrow to Frankfurt on November the fifth (Booking Reference: WX78KL; Baggage Tag Number: 0125894). Upon collecting my hard-shell suitcase from the arrivals carousel, I discovered that the outer polycarbonate casing was cracked down the entire spine, one wheel had been completely sheared off, and the primary zipper was torn open.

Upon inspecting the contents at the airport baggage service desk, I noticed that several items were missing, presumably having fallen out during baggage transit. The missing belongings comprise a pair of designer leather boots valued at £180 and an electric grooming kit worth £75, totaling £255 in unrecovered property. I filed a Property Irregularity Report (PIR number: FRA-BA-3392) before exiting customs.

Given that the suitcase itself is damaged beyond repair (original purchase price £140), I request total reimbursement of £395 to cover the replacement suitcase and missing possessions. Copies of my receipts and the PIR document are attached.

I look forward to hearing from you within fourteen business days.

Yours faithfully,

Jonathan Davies
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Covers all required points with precise flight details and itemized monetary claims. Tone: Assertive, professional, and compliant with consumer claims standards.

checklist: Flight number and booking ref included

planningGuide.tips: State flight number, date, route, and property irregularity reference.
Describe torn fabric, broken wheel assembly, and crushed personal items.
Request replacement cost or prompt reimbursement with enclosed receipts.
Use Yours faithfully.

title: Letter Inviting a Former Colleague to Attend a Farewell Dinner
promptText:
A popular colleague at your workplace is leaving the company, and you are organizing a farewell dinner for them.

Write an email to a former colleague who used to work closely with this person. In your email:
- Tell them about the colleague's departure and explain the dinner plans
- Remind them of a fond memory or shared project they worked on together
- Ask if they can attend and request their dietary preferences and RSVP by a specific date.

sampleAnswers.text:
Hi Liam,

Hope you are doing really well and enjoying your new role!

I'm writing with some bittersweet news from the office: after nine fantastic years at Zenith Media, Karen has decided to take up an exciting new director position in Edinburgh. As you can imagine, we couldn't let her leave without throwing a proper celebration, so we are organizing a farewell dinner on Friday, December the thirteenth, at seven PM at The Olive Grove Italian bistro downtown.

I know how closely the two of you worked together on the landmark Nordic tourism campaign back in 2022—we were all reminiscing the other day about the hilarious frantic scramble we had right before the final pitch! Karen would be absolutely thrilled if you could join us to celebrate her next chapter.

Could you let me know by next Monday, December the second, whether you can make it? Also, please let me know if you have any special dietary requirements so I can confirm the set menu with the restaurant.

Really hope you can make it—it would be wonderful to catch up properly!

All the best,

Sophie
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Hits all points with an engaging, natural informal register. Tone: Warm, friendly, and appropriately conversational.

planningGuide.tips: Mention farewell dinner details, date, venue, and how much everyone misses them.
Describe attendees, private dining room, and speeches/slideshow planned.
Ask for confirmation by Friday and offer a lift or accommodation if needed.
Use Best wishes or Warmly followed by first name.

title: Letter to Landlord Requesting Urgent Repair of Central Heating
promptText:
You rent an apartment and the central heating boiler has stopped working in the middle of winter.

Write a letter to your landlord. In your letter:
- Describe the boiler malfunction and explain when it stopped working
- Explain how this is affecting your daily living conditions
- Request immediate repair and state what action you will take if it is not resolved.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Mr. Jenkins,

I am writing to formally report an urgent heating breakdown at Flat 3B, 18 Parkside Terrace, which requires your immediate intervention.

Yesterday evening at around seven PM, the combi-boiler in the kitchen suddenly ceased functioning. The digital display is showing an error code 'F22' indicating low water pressure and ignition lockout. The pilot flame will not ignite, leaving the apartment without central heating or hot water.

With overnight ambient temperatures currently plunging below zero degrees Celsius, the indoor temperature has dropped to ten degrees. This situation is making living conditions inside the flat unbearable, particularly as I have a young child in the household.

Under our tenancy agreement and Section 11 of the Landlord and Tenant Act, landlords are legally obligated to maintain space heating and water installations in working order. I request that you dispatch an emergency Gas Safe registered engineer to service the boiler within the next twenty-four hours. If this issue is not rectified by tomorrow evening, I will have no alternative but to arrange an independent emergency heating engineer and deduct the invoice from next month's rent.

I await your urgent phone call.

Yours sincerely,

Michael Scott
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Full coverage of all prompts with appropriate legal awareness. Tone: Firm, respectful, and appropriately urgent.

checklist: Error code and boiler details cited

planningGuide.tips: State address, tenancy details, and complete loss of central heating and hot water.
Explain freezing sub-zero weather and risk to health.
Request registered gas-safe engineer visit within 24 hours per tenancy agreement.
Use Yours sincerely.

title: Letter Recommending a Friend for a Job Opening at Your Company
promptText:
You work for a company that has an opening for a Graphic Designer. A friend of yours has the right qualifications and experience for the role.

Write an email to your company's Hiring Manager. In your email:
- State the role you are writing about and introduce your friend
- Explain their professional qualifications and relevant past achievements
- Describe their personal work ethic and why they would be a great fit for the team.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear Ms. Hargrove,

I am writing to enthusiastically recommend a professional colleague and friend, Daniel Brooks, for the Senior Graphic Designer vacancy currently advertised on our internal careers board.

Daniel holds a First-Class Bachelor of Arts degree in Visual Communication from the London College of Communication. Over the past five years, he served as Lead UI Designer at Creative Bloom Agency, where he spearheaded the complete brand identity redesign for three major fintech clients. His portfolio demonstrates exceptional versatility across Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and responsive web design typography.

Beyond his formidable technical capabilities, Daniel possesses an exemplary work ethic. Having collaborated with him on several freelance branding initiatives, I know firsthand that he thrives under tight deadlines and welcomes collaborative critique. He is an empathetic communicator who excels at translating complex client briefs into compelling visual narratives.

I am confident Daniel would make an outstanding addition to our creative department. I have attached his portfolio link and resume for your review.

Thank you for considering this recommendation.

Warm regards,

Claire Vance
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Comprehensive professional endorsement covering skills, achievements, and cultural fit. Tone: Polished semi-formal register.

planningGuide.tips: State friend name, job reference code, and endorsement for the role.
Highlight technical competence, collaborative spirit, and past accomplishments.
Emphasize punctuality, integrity, and why they would excel in the team.
Use Kind regards with title.

title: Letter to Sports Club Manager Suggesting Facility Improvements
promptText:
You are a regular member of a local gym and sports center, and you feel that certain facilities need upgrading.

Write a letter to the General Manager. In your letter:
- State how long you have been a member and what you enjoy about the club
- Identify the specific facilities or equipment that require repair or improvement
- Explain how these upgrades would benefit the wider membership.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear General Manager,

I am writing as a dedicated member of the Riverside Health and Fitness Club to provide constructive feedback regarding several facilities that would greatly benefit from modernization.

I have been an active member of your club for over four years, and I consistently appreciate the welcoming staff and the high standard of your swimming facilities.

However, several areas in the free weights zone and locker rooms have fallen into disrepair. In the strength training area, three of the cable pulleys are out of order, and the dumbbell racks lack paired weights between sixteen and twenty-four kilograms. Furthermore, in the male locker room, two shower cubicles suffer from persistent low water pressure, and several locker digital keypads are unresponsive.

Upgrading the weight resistance machinery and modernizing the locker room amenities would dramatically enhance the daily member experience, reducing wait times during peak morning and evening hours. Investing in these essential improvements would undoubtedly increase member retention and attract new patrons.

Thank you for taking the time to review my suggestions.

Yours sincerely,

Robert Green
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Covers all three bullet points with balanced praise and actionable recommendations. Tone: Polite and constructive.

planningGuide.tips: State years of club membership and general satisfaction with facilities.
Describe locker room ventilation issues and peak-hour gym equipment queues.
Propose online booking slots and upgraded dehumidifiers.
Use Yours sincerely.

title: Letter to Hotel Manager Commending Exceptional Customer Service
promptText:
You recently stayed at a hotel and received exceptional assistance from a member of the staff during an emergency.

Write a letter to the Hotel General Manager. In your letter:
- State your stay details and describe the emergency situation
- Explain how the staff member assisted you and went above and beyond their duty
- Recommend an appropriate acknowledgment or reward for this employee.

sampleAnswers.text:
Dear General Manager,

I am writing to express my profound gratitude for the exemplary service provided by your front-desk receptionist, Marco Rossi, during my recent stay at the Grand Harborside Hotel.

My wife and I stayed in Room 412 from October the twelfth to the fourteenth. In the early hours of Sunday morning, my wife experienced a severe allergic reaction to medication, accompanied by acute breathing difficulties. Panicked and unfamiliar with the local area, I phoned the reception desk for assistance.

Marco responded with extraordinary professionalism and composure. He immediately summoned an emergency paramedic ambulance and sprinted up to our room with an oxygen-equipped emergency medical kit. He remained calmly by our side, reassuring my distressed wife, and escorted the paramedics directly to our room upon their arrival. His rapid, level-headed intervention undoubtedly averted a medical tragedy.

Marco is a tremendous credit to your hospitality group. I strongly recommend that his decisive actions be formally recognized with an Employee of the Month award and a commemorative commendation in his personnel file.

Yours sincerely,

Arthur Pendelton
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Eloquent, detailed narrative fulfilling all requirements. Tone: Formal and heartfelt commendation.

planningGuide.tips: Mention booking reference, stay dates, room number, and reason for commendation.
Detail exceptional assistance provided by front desk staff member during a medical issue.
Commend staff training standards and confirm future return stays.
Use Yours faithfully.

title: Letter Asking a Neighbor to Look After Your Cat While Away
promptText:
You are going away on vacation for two weeks and need someone to take care of your pet cat.

Write an email to a friendly neighbor. In your email:
- Tell them about your upcoming holiday and ask if they can care for your cat
- Explain the daily feeding and care routine
- Offer a gesture of appreciation and provide your contact information.

sampleAnswers.text:
Hi Sarah,

Hope you and the family are having a wonderful week!

I'm writing to ask a huge favor. David and I are heading to Italy for a two-week holiday from July the tenth to the twenty-fourth. We were wondering if you might be willing to look after our cat, Whiskers, while we are away?

He is very low-maintenance, but he needs to be fed twice a day—one pouch of wet food in the morning at eight AM and a small scoop of dry biscuits in the evening. His fresh water bowl just needs a daily rinse and refill, and the litter box in the utility room should be scooped once every couple of days. He loves a quick chin rub if you have a minute to spare!

I will leave a spare house key in a lockbox by our front door, along with emergency vet contact details. We would love to treat you to dinner at your favorite Italian bistro when we get back as a small token of our gratitude, and I'd be more than happy to return the favor whenever you travel.

Please let me know if this works for you!

Warmly,

Emma
sampleAnswers.examinerCommentary: Task Achievement: Addresses all points warmly and clearly. Tone: Natural, friendly, and considerate neighborly informal tone.

planningGuide.tips: Friendly greeting, dates of upcoming vacation, and ask to watch pet cat.
Explain feeding routine, water bowl, litter box, and favorite toys.
Leave emergency vet contact, spare key location, and promise a gift upon return.
Use Warmly or Best.
